description: Generate a brand-aware set of interview questions for capturing the brand's story and voice (8 by default, 4 to 20 with count; steer biases the set). Returns the questions. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

steer.description: Optional steering hint to bias the question set.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_generate_brand_interview_questions
title: Generate Brand Interview Questions
